gloss: the prewar generation; prewar school (of thought)

definitions.gloss: the prewar generation; people of the prewar era
definitions.explanation: People who were born and grew up before World War II, or whose values and outlook were shaped in that era. Often contrasted with the postwar generation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{戦前派|せんぜんは}だ。
examples.english: My grandfather is of the prewar generation.

examples.japanese: {戦前派|せんぜんは}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{考|かんが}え{方|かた}→考え方：10169_kangaekata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
examples.english: The prewar generation's way of thinking differs from today's.

examples.japanese: {戦前派|せんぜんは}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{古典|こてん}→古典：00242_koten⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{素養|そよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many prewar-generation writers have a deep grounding in the classics.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{戦前|せんぜん}→戦前：12852_senzen⟧ (prewar) and the suffix ⟦{派|は}→派：28356_ha⟧ (faction, school, group).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {戦前派|せんぜんは}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世代|せだい}→世代：05102_sedai⟧: the prewar generation
- {戦前派|せんぜんは}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{価値観|かちかん}→価値観：10431_kachikan⟧: prewar-generation values

SIMILAR WORDS:
